descriptions.notStarted: I've lost my appetite as of late... I wonder if Tangyoon could help me find a newfound appreciation for food by cooking me something new? I'm definitely ready for the challenge now so I should go talk to Tangyoon in The Nautilus' cafeteria. Oh yea, the cafeteria's on the upper deck.

He says that he could make something new and fresh if only I would bring him #b40 Evil Eye Tails#k... But come on, Evil Eyes?
